rule_texts: Assign Route 01 Ready if the current specimen was collected within the past 48 hours and its accession matches the current patient, unless the laboratory has rejected that specimen.

Assign Route 01 Preparation if it is false that the current specimen was collected within the past 48 hours and its accession matches the current patient, unless the laboratory has rejected that specimen.
If the laboratory has rejected that specimen, assign Route 01 Exception; this exception takes precedence over the other two branches.
newness: New subject-specific workflow propositions and narratives; logical operators are intentionally shared with earlier experiments.
